title: UK accused of ‘stark injustice’ as woman from Montserrat refused free NHS care
summary: Cherry Brown, 69, a British overseas territory citizen, was left sleeping rough after being sent to England for treatment The UK has been accused of a “stark injustice” for failing to provide health services and humanitarian support to citizens of British overseas territories after a woman from the Caribbean island of Montserrat was refused free NHS care and left homeless. Council officials found Cherry Brown, 69, sleeping rough in a park in Swanley, Kent, in April. Brown had been funded by the Montserratian government – whose budget is largely subsidised by the UK – to travel to England to receive treatment from the NHS that was not available at home.
